item.title: Circle secures NYDFS limited-purpose trust charter to provide custody and asset-management services under New York Banking Law
US federal agencies miss one-year GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules, extending regulatory uncertainty for issuers
BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs, and SoFi formally back the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act
European Commission opens MiCA review consultation through Aug. 31, including potential revision of stablecoin interest ban
MiCA transition deadline reduced authorized EU crypto service providers to roughly 230 firms, eliminating ~80% of registrations
SEC issues no-action letter for DTC tokenization; Nasdaq approved to list tokenized securities alongside conventional shares
US Treasury opens second public comment round on GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
Tokenized real-world assets surpass $30 billion globally, up approximately sixfold from the start of 2025
Tokenized equity volumes rose 288% to a record $11.3 billion following the EU MiCA transitional period expiry
Institutions accounted for a record 72% of crypto spot volume in H1 2026, up from 61% in H2 2025, per Wintermute data
Senate shelves Digital Asset Market Clarity Act until after August recess; industry awaits upper chamber's return
Augustus raises $180 million at $1 billion valuation to build a federally chartered stablecoin-era clearing bank
OCC authorizes US national banks to conduct digital asset custody services without obtaining prior agency approval
EDX Markets closes $76 million Series C funding round led by SBI Holdings
